name: SAR Filing Happy Path — Automated Trigger to NCA Submission
description: End-to-end sequence for the JRN-003 happy path. Trigger: SanctionsHitDetected automated event received by SVC-014. MLRO investigates, decides to file, prepares and submits SAR to NCA within 5 business days. No consent regime required. Account restrictions applied post-filing.

steps.label: SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) consumed
steps.detail: SVC-014 receives SanctionsHitDetected event. Payload: { customer_id, event_instance_id, match_confidence, list_name }

steps.label: POST /investigations — create SARInvestigationRecord
steps.detail: SVC-014 creates ENT-009: trigger_type=automated_event, status=open. investigation_id assigned.

steps.label: Publish SARInvestigationOpened (EVT-014)
steps.detail: Payload: { investigation_id, customer_id, trigger_type, trigger_timestamp }

steps.label: SARInvestigationOpened → SVC-103 WORM log
steps.detail: Audit log entry created. Immutable.

steps.label: MLRO case management alert triggered
steps.detail: Secure internal notification sent to MLRO: new investigation opened. No email — internal case management system only.

steps.label: MLRO opens investigation in case management UI
steps.detail: Step-up MFA authentication required. MLRO reviews trigger details.

steps.label: GET /investigations/{investigation_id}
steps.detail: SVC-015 retrieves SARInvestigationRecord. Returns investigation data, trigger detail, empty evidence_items, timeline.

steps.label: GET /kyc/assessments/customer/{customer_id}
steps.detail: MLRO reviews KycAssessment (ENT-003) — sanctions result, PEP status, risk score, EDD history.

steps.label: GET /accounts/{account_id}/transactions (date range)
steps.detail: MLRO reviews transaction history for relevant period. SVC-001 returns transaction list.

steps.label: MLRO adds evidence items
steps.detail: MLRO documents investigation findings.

steps.label: POST /investigations/{id}/evidence (x N items)
steps.detail: Each evidence item appended to SARInvestigationRecord.evidence_items. WORM — immutable after addition.

steps.label: MLRO records decision: file_sar
steps.detail: MLRO enters decision and rationale (min 200 chars). Advances investigation to decision_pending.

steps.label: POST /sars — CreateSARRequest
steps.detail: SVC-015 creates SuspiciousActivityReport (ENT-008): status=draft, mlro_decision=file_sar, mlro_decision_date=today. SLA clock starts.

steps.label: Publish SARDecisionMade (EVT-015)
steps.detail: Payload: { sar_id, investigation_id, customer_id, decision=file_sar, decision_date, sla_deadline }

steps.label: SARDecisionMade → SVC-103 WORM log
steps.detail: Decision immutably logged.

steps.label: MLRO completes NCA SAR form fields
steps.detail: Investigation summary, transaction details, account details, typology codes populated.

steps.label: PATCH /sars/{sar_id} — UpdateSARRequest
steps.detail: SAR fields updated: investigation_summary, transaction_details, account_details.

steps.label: MLRO confirms tipping-off review and marks SAR ready
steps.detail: MLRO ticks mandatory tipping-off review confirmation checkbox. Status advanced to ready_for_submission.

steps.label: PATCH /sars/{sar_id} — status: ready_for_submission
steps.detail: SAR status transitions to ready_for_submission.

steps.label: MLRO triggers SAR submission
steps.detail: Submit button enabled only when tipping_off_review_confirmed = true and status = ready_for_submission.

steps.label: POST /sars/{sar_id}/submit
steps.detail: SubmitSARRequest: { tipping_off_review_confirmed: true, submission_channel: sar_online_api, mlro_id }

steps.label: POST NCA SAR Online API — submit SAR payload
steps.detail: SVC-014 assembles NCA SAR form from ENT-008 and ENT-001 data. Submits to NCA SAR Online API. Retry: 3 attempts, exponential backoff.

steps.label: NCA acknowledgement: 200 OK with nca_reference
steps.detail: NCA returns reference number. SVC-014 stores in SuspiciousActivityReport.nca_reference. filed_date = now(). status = filed. sla_status computed.

steps.label: Publish SARFiled (EVT-016)
steps.detail: Payload (minimal, tipping-off safe): { sar_id, customer_id, restriction_required: true, filed_at }

steps.label: SARFiled consumed by SVC-001
steps.detail: SVC-001 reads restriction_required flag. Does NOT receive NCA reference or SAR narrative.

steps.label: SARFiled → SVC-103 WORM log
steps.detail: Filing event immutably logged.

steps.label: SVC-001 applies enhanced monitoring flag to customer accounts
steps.detail: Account.enhanced_monitoring_flag = true. No customer-facing notification with SAR reference.

steps.label: Publish AccountRestrictionApplied (EVT-019)
steps.detail: Payload: { customer_id, account_ids, restriction_type: enhanced_monitoring, applied_at }

steps.label: MLRO submits confirmation: investigation closed
steps.detail: MLRO closes SARInvestigationRecord: status = closed, closed_at = now().

tipping_off_controls_highlighted: Step 24: SARFiled event payload contains only customer_id and restriction_required — no SAR narrative, no NCA reference
Step 25: SVC-001 receives no SAR detail — only the restriction signal
Step 27: No customer notification is sent at any stage
Step 21: tipping_off_review_confirmed = true is a mandatory prerequisite for submission
